items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Johnny Winters. Didn’t he do “Parchman Farm”?

ctx.x: The Kingston Trio did something that they never...
The Yardbirds. Gosh, a whole bunch. I’m trying to remember who else. Johnny Winters. Didn’t he do “Parchman Farm”?
this clip from All About Jazz states that “Parchman Farm” was covered by Johnny Winter, Cactus, Blue Cheer, Rick Derringer, John Mayall, and Hot Tuna.
